description: Na₂ZrWO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.86 Å. Zr is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Zr-O bond lengths are 2.10 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.95 Å. O is bonded to four equivalent Na, one Zr, and one W atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₄ZrW octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-60°.
